# Gemini Minecraft plugin
![Enviroment Server](https://img.shields.io/badge/environment-server-1976d2?style=flat-square)

This plugin allows you to communicate with Google Gemini from your Minecraft server! All you need is an API key and to select a model!

---
## 📖 How install?
Simply upload it to the “plugins” folder of your Minecraft server running version 1.21.x. Then open: “/plugins/gemini/config.yml”, select the desired language: “ru/en/kz”, as well as the [Gemini model](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models) and your [Google AI Developer key](https://aistudio.google.com/app/api-keys)

---
## ⚡ Advantages
- Multilangual (Supported languages: Russian (ru), English (en), Kazakh (kz)
- Async (You won't be left hanging while waiting for a response)
- Fast (The fastest access to Google APIs in the wild west)
